<!--
wjschne/apaquarto#168. A data table takes the reference document's Table
style, which draws the rules of an APA table; only the grid quarto lays
panels out in takes FigureLayout, which draws none.

docxlayout.lua gave every table in a captioned float FigureLayout, and
apafloat.lua marks tables as floats as well as figures, so a captioned
markdown table, with a note or without, was set in Word with no rules at
all. A table written by a code chunk escaped, being one div further down.
The tables of a table laid out in panels are data tables too; the grid
holding them is not.
-->
